name: Michael R.
paragraphs: I hired Mr. Ding after my custody situation became increasingly complicated. I was frustrated and honestly had a hard time trusting the legal process at that point.

One thing I appreciated was that he actually went through the messages and documents I sent him. I had a lot of things I wanted to bring up in court, and he explained that some of them really weren't going to help my case. I didn't always agree with him at first, but I understood his reasoning.
He was prepared at the hearing and knew the details of my situation. I was pretty nervous going in, but it helped knowing that we had already gone over what to expect.
I won't pretend the whole process was easy. There were some difficult decisions along the way. But I felt that Mr. Ding took my concerns seriously and gave me good advice when I needed it.

name: Sarah Thompson
paragraphs: I was nervous about hiring an attorney because of how expensive divorce can get. David was upfront about his fees and didn't make me feel like every little disagreement needed to turn into a legal battle.
At one point I wanted to fight over something that, looking back, really wasn't worth the time or money. He talked me through the options and the likely costs.
I appreciated that. He could have just done what I asked and billed for it.
Overall a good experience during a pretty unpleasant time in my life. Would recommend.

name: Daniel K.
paragraphs: I contacted Mr. Ding regarding a restraining order case. It was a stressful situation and I had never dealt with anything like it before.
He asked a lot of questions during our meetings, including some I wasn't expecting. I could tell he was trying to understand what actually happened rather than just agreeing with everything I said.
He also helped me sort through the evidence I had collected. There was quite a bit of it, and not all of it was particularly useful.
I appreciated his preparation and how he handled himself during the hearing. He was calm and professional even when things got tense.
I am glad I had his help.

name: Kevin Zhang
paragraphs: My divorce involved a house, some investments, and money my parents had given me over the years. I originally thought it would be pretty simple to show where everything came from. Turned out it was more complicated than I expected.
David spent time going through the bank records with me and explaining what documents we needed. Some of the transfers were from years ago, so getting everything together wasn't easy.
What I liked was that he would tell me when something was uncertain instead of giving me an answer just to make me feel better.
He was also patient with my questions. I probably asked some of the same things more than once because I was worried about losing money that my family had given me.
I appreciated the help and the explanations throughout the process.

name: Michelle Chen
paragraphs: I needed someone to review a prenup before my wedding and found Mr. Ding.

He went through the agreement with me and pointed out several provisions I hadn't really understood. I had read the document myself, but some of the language was confusing, especially the parts dealing with future income and property.
He explained what the provisions could mean and suggested a few changes. I also appreciated that he didn't make everything sound like a huge problem.
The review helped me feel more comfortable with what I was signing. Good experience overall.

name: Jennifer P.
paragraphs: David helped me with my divorce last year. He was patient with all my questions and explained things in a way I could understand.
There were a few times I was upset about what was happening and wanted to respond right away. He helped me think things through first, which I appreciated.
Divorce is stressful enough as it is. I'm glad I had someone levelheaded helping me through it.
